Hi Samir / Lina —

Thanks again for committing to the POC. We'd like to run a coordinated kickoff + hands-on working session where we cover:
- 15m kickoff & goals alignment
- 45–60m prompt review and routing config (prompt templates, system messages, fallback routing)
- 45m load rehearsal (ramp, KV/cache behavior, and monitoring hooks)
- 30m runbook + next steps (rollout checklist, shared artifacts)

Two windows that work for our team:
- Tue Apr 19, 09:00–12:00 PT (hands-on studio + smoke load test)
- Thu Apr 22, 10:00–13:00 PT (full rehearsal with ramp to target throughput)

Action items for your side before the session:
1) Share 6–8 representative prompts and a short description of routing logic you expect (e.g., by intent). A sample file format is fine.
2) Confirm target throughput for the rehearsal (suggested start: 20 RPS ramp to 60 RPS over 5 minutes; tell us if you want a different target).
3) Provide any restricted test data access or credentials (if needed) and procurement contact for SOW/PO.

I've attached a draft agenda and a preliminary prep questionnaire to help the team prepare. Ben will run the calendar coordination once you confirm the preferred date.

Attachments: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf, prep_questions.md

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marissa
